faqs.question: Which is cheaper for a 10-person team?
faqs.answer: ClickUp is /month (10 x ). Notion is /month (10 x ). ClickUp saves /year. Both offer free tiers if budget is tight.

faqs.question: Can I use both ClickUp and Notion together?
faqs.answer: Yes, many teams use Notion for documentation and ClickUp for project management. They integrate natively. This combo works well when docs and task management need different tools.

faqs.question: Which is easier for non-technical teams?
faqs.answer: ClickUp is easier for task management. Notion is easier for documentation. For mixed teams, ClickUp's interface is more intuitive for people who have never used PM software.

faqs.question: How long does it take to migrate between them?
faqs.answer: Migration takes 1-2 weeks for a 10-person team. ClickUp has a Notion importer. Notion can import from CSV. Plan for 20-30 hours of data cleanup and team training.

faqs.question: Which has better customer support?
faqs.answer: Both offer email and chat support. ClickUp has faster response times (under 2 hours for paid plans). Notion has a larger community and more third-party tutorials.

description: ClickUp vs Notion for small teams (5-20 people) compared: pricing at team scale, feature depth, onboarding time, and which tool your team will actually adopt.
verdict: For small teams that need an all-in-one tool, ClickUp wins. It has better task management, built-in time tracking, and faster onboarding. Notion wins for teams that prioritize documentation and knowledge sharing. Choose ClickUp if you want project management + docs in one tool. Choose Notion if your team lives in docs and wikis.
title: ClickUp vs Notion for Small Teams 2026: Which One Fits?
